subject: mathematics
concept: Finding the volume of composite solids made from two or more cuboids
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student splits a virtual composite solid into separate cuboids and finds each volume
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a dividing line on a pictured composite solid to split it into cuboids
exercise.abstract: Student calculates total volume of a composite solid by summing cuboid parts

misconception_flags: double-counts an overlapping section or omits part of the composite solid

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
